subject: Azure Partner Center: co-sell ownership token & mapping cadence
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Logan <sarah.logan@contoso.com>, Azure Partner Center Support <pc-support@microsoft.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Partner Center — ownership token proposal and mapping cadence

Team —

Quick note to align on an operational fix for Partner Center referral churn we've been seeing on Contoso (deal referenced in HubSpot). Problem in short: referrals are landing without a durable owner assertion in our system; field sellers overwrite each other when accounts get re-assigned in Partner Center and our billing/crediting logic loses the "consent/ownership" signal. That causes downstream co-sell status flaps and delay for CA/PS approvals.

Proposal (high level):
- Introduce an "ownership token" (immutable identifier) issued at the moment of Partner Center referral ingestion.
- Token maps to an entitlement lane (self-serve / commercial / enterprise) and is reconciled daily against Seller Consent status from Partner Center.
- Define a weekly "owner-assertion cadence" where sellers confirm consent or the token auto-escalates to field RO (routing rules attached).

I've attached a draft schema (pc_ownership_token_schema.xlsx) with suggested fields: token_id, source_referral_id, seller_id, entitlement_lane, consent_flag, last_sync_ts.

Asks:
1) Vanessa — any operational constraints from your side for mass re-mapping of ~2.1k referrals?
2) Karthik — can your intake pipeline produce a backfill that assigns token_id for existing referrals?
3) Laura — will MAP (mutual action plan) changes be required for the AE/CS handoff?

If this reads well I'll open a short working stream this week and loop Contoso for sign-off.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
priym.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: pc_ownership_token_schema.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Sarah Logan <sarah.logan@contoso.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center — ownership token proposal and mapping cadence

Thanks Priyom — good framing. A few quick operational notes: 

- We need seller consent recorded in two places: Partner Center's seller_consent flag and our local consent_flag. The token should prefer Partner Center as source-of-truth and fall back to last known local consent.
- For mass re-mapping: we can run an update job but will require a rate-limited rollout (50 accounts / minute) to avoid throttling our internal audit logs. Plan for a 48-hour window for full backfill.
- Marketplace listing IDs matter for co-sell qualification. Please add listing_id to the schema (so entitlement_lane can be evaluated per-offer).

On escalations: when token auto-escalates to field RO, we'd like to create a Slack/Email alert to the designated seller owner. Also we should exclude accounts where Contoso has active procurement holds.

I'll drop inline comments in the spreadsheet.

-V

Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center — ownership token proposal and mapping cadence

Nice; thanks both. Two pragmatic steps from engineering to make this operational: 

1) Backfill script: ingest current Partner Center referrals, emit token_id (uuid v4) and write to attachments/token_mapping_v1.csv. We will include columns: referral_id, token_id, seller_id, listing_id, lane_candidate, initial_consent_flag. Expect runtime ~3 hours for 2.1k rows if we stream in batches of 250 and parallelize to 4 workers.

2) Reconciliation loop: daily job that pulls Partner Center delta (since last_sync_ts) and updates consent_flag, seller_id, and if seller_id changes we evaluate owner-claim policy:
   - If new seller_claim within 24h of referral creation => allow update (low risk)
   - If seller_claim after 24h => freeze token and route to human review (creates a work item in JIRA SUP-6739)

Pseudocode (super-brief):
   if partnercenter.seller_consent(referral_id) == true: set local.consent_flag = true
   else: local.consent_flag = false; if consecutive_missed_syncs > 3: escalate_to_field(seller_id)

Entitlement lanes (proposal): self-serve | commercial | strategic. Lanes influence routing and crediting. We will add logic to map listing_id -> default_lane and allow manual override by field RO.

I'm attaching the initial CSV with sample mappings (token_mapping_v1.csv). Also proposing we use DocuSign for a "Seller Consent Addendum" to make consent traceable for audits — link below in the DocuSign template.

-Karthik

Attachment: token_mapping_v1.csv (CSV)
